objective: Process the heterogeneously formatted open-science data ingested from the FAIR discovery phase. Convert native scientific formats (NetCDF, GeoTIFF) into WENDY's standardized, precision-scaled PSVC binary payloads, ensuring zero loss of geospatial referencing or scientific metadata.
processing_rules: Parse NetCDF/GeoTIFF geospatial bounds and reproject to WGS84 if necessary.
Cast continuous scientific variables (e.g., soil moisture %, elevation) to strict np.float16 precision to minimize mesh bandwidth.
Attach the original dataset's DOI, license, and source URL to the PSVC container metadata.
Calculate the Shannon entropy of the standardized array to determine optimal volunteer node routing.
